source_evidence: If you feel the fees charged to you are excessive, contact the SEC, FINRA or NASAA to report your concern.
answer: If you believe a broker’s miscellaneous fee is too high, you can contact the SEC, FINRA, or NASAA to report your concern. You can also ask the broker questions and, if you are not satisfied, consider contacting the broker in writing. For a question, concern, or complaint about an investment, the source also recommends contacting one of these organizations or your state securities regulator for assistance.
